name: PT Sillo Maritime Perdana Tbk
summary: PT Sillo Maritime Perdana Tbk operates as a marine service provider company in Indonesia. It is also involved in the vessel rental; shipping services to support oil and gas exploration and production activities. In addition, the company provides transportation, boat rental, and trading services, as well as vessel charter and other marine services. Its fleet includes floating storage offloading (FSO), liquefied gas carriers, anchor handling tug supply, large gas carriers, liquefied natural gas and liquefied petroleum gas tankers, oil tankers, crew boats, harbour tugs, supply vessels, oil barges, and utility vessels.
